documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with Q2 revenue from operations growing 54.8% YoY to INR 818.7 crores. The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand into new categories such as silver, platinum, CVD lab-grown diamonds, and online B2C channels. Additionally, its entry into the bridal jewellery segment has achieved encouraging traction, contributing approximately 10% of overall manufacturing volume. Management is focusing on expanding its corporate business share to 65% to improve payment cycles and cash flows. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported its H1 FY27 financial results, with revenue from operations reaching ₹1,367.15 crore and PAT rising to ₹73.47 crore with a 5.37% PAT margin.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting to scale its corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: Increasing corporate business share is expected to improve the company's business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.
guidance.quote: This will improve our business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.

guidance.claim: Management expects production from the current capacity to ramp up in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: End-market demand environment remains encouraging due to the ongoing festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary designs, and affordable products continues to create market opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty have made consumers more cautious regarding their spending.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail store network expansions by corporate clientele are expected to drive higher product demand for the company.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: Shringar House complements its in-house manufacturing capacity with outsourced production to meet growing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed subsidiary will explore opportunities across both B2B and B2C channels.
capex_expansion.quote: It will also enable us to explore opportunities across both B2B and B2C channels, including physical retail formats and digital platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: The subsidiary will be set up with a initial minimal funding of INR 2 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We can, but for this, we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture.

capex_expansion.claim: Shringar House invested approximately ₹15 crore through internal accruals for expanding capacity and upgrading machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from the expanded capacity resumed on February 23, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune to build its nationwide supply chain network.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 6.7%, growing by 50 bps year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 reached INR 68 crores, reflecting an increase of 53.1% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter at INR68 crores, an increase of 53.1% Y-0-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased due to headcount expansion required for higher capacity and the bridal segment.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: Higher gold prices improve company profitability due to percentage-based charging structures.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded a PAT of ₹73.47 crore in H1 FY27 with a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: • PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 FY27 sales volume stood at 577 kgs, up 10% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing capacity has been expanded from 2.5 tonnes to 4 tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

orders_capacity.claim: Bridal jewellery currently accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume.
orders_capacity.quote: So, within our entire manufacturing operations, the bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Following new capacity addition in February 2026, full-year blended capacity stood at 2,625 kgs with an actual utilization rate of 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: * The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: Shringar House holds an integrated manufacturing capacity of 4,000 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains at least 30% plus hedged inventory out of its total inventory of approximately 400 kgs.
capital_allocation.quote: Right now we keep at least 30% plus hedged inventory. Minimum is 30%, minimum 30% plus we keep hedged. Approximately 400 kgs is our inventory, 400 kgs.

capital_allocation.claim: Streamlining and improving the cash flow cycle is the primary top priority for business growth.
capital_allocation.quote: To grow the business, our first step was to streamline and improve our cash flow cycle, and we are actively working on it.

capital_allocation.claim: The public listing of the company provided funds to support business growth.
capital_allocation.quote: • Listing of the company enabled growth funds

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty present caution among consumers regarding spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's business operations require significant working capital liquidity to fund multi-location expansion.
risks_headwinds.quote:
• Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring
adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and
diversification across multiple locations

management_commitments.claim: The bridal jewellery business share is expected to reach a level comparable to the core business within two to two-and-a-half years.
management_commitments.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the expanded capacity is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
